private.labels: executed through matching Racket program for every pair
private.program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((all-vals (apply append g))
                (bg (mode-list all-vals))
                (other-colors (filter (lambda (v) (!= v bg)) (unique all-vals)))
                (c1 (first other-colors))
                (c2 (find-first (lambda (v) (!= v c1)) other-colors))
                (bb1 (bbox-of-cells (find-color g c1)))
                (r1min (first bb1))
                (c1min (second bb1))
                (r1max (third bb1))
                (c1max (fourth bb1))
                (bb2 (bbox-of-cells (find-color g c2)))
                (r2min (first bb2))
                (c2min (second bb2))
                (r2max (third bb2))
                (c2max (fourth bb2)))
           (cellmap g
                    (r c v)
                    (cond
                      ((< c1max c2min) (let* ((gs (+ c1max 1))
                               (ge (- c2min 1))
                               (gl (+ 1 (- ge gs)))
                               (half (/ gl 2)))
                          (cond
                            ((and (>= c gs) (< c (+ gs half))) c1)
                            ((and (>= c (+ 1 (- ge half))) (<= c ge)) c2)
                            (else v))))
                      ((< c2max c1min) (let* ((gs (+ c2max 1))
                               (ge (- c1min 1))
                               (gl (+ 1 (- ge gs)))
                               (half (/ gl 2)))
                          (cond
                            ((and (>= c gs) (< c (+ gs half))) c2)
                            ((and (>= c (+ 1 (- ge half))) (<= c ge)) c1)
                            (else v))))
                      ((< r1max r2min) (let* ((gs (+ r1max 1))
                               (ge (- r2min 1))
                               (gl (+ 1 (- ge gs)))
                               (half (/ gl 2)))
                          (cond
                            ((and (>= r gs) (< r (+ gs half))) c1)
                            ((and (>= r (+ 1 (- ge half))) (<= r ge)) c2)
                            (else v))))
                      (else (let* ((gs (+ r2max 1))
                                   (ge (- r1min 1))
                                   (gl (+ 1 (- ge gs)))
                                   (half (/ gl 2)))
                              (cond
                                ((and (>= r gs) (< r (+ gs half))) c2)
                                ((and (>= r (+ 1 (- ge half))) (<= r ge)) c1)
                                (else v)))))))))
